content: संदानम् .²1 A rope, cord. .²2 A chain, fetter; ‘संदानं पशूनां पादबन्धनम्’ इति विश्वः. .²3 Cutting, dividing. .²4 That part of an elephantʼs temples whence the ichor (मद) exudes. .{@-नः@} That part of an elephant under the knee where the fetter is fastened; संदानान्तादस्त्रिभिः शिक्षितास्त्रैः <ls>Śi. 18. 71</ls>.
